items.label: Profile
items.content: Product and UX designer-builder who takes creative tools from first idea to shipped product at the intersection of real-time 3D, generative AI, and storytelling, the exact space Intangible works in. Designed and shipped Adventure Portal, a real-time multiplayer VR experience with hands-on control of composition, camera, and pacing, piloted at the Telus World of Science (4.84/5, NPS 84) and distributed to 400+ venues. Turns complex spatial and AI capabilities into clear, learnable workflows, prototypes fast to test ideas, and partners closely with engineering and artists to carry concepts through to high-quality, real-world implementation.

jobs.title: Founder & Lead Designer
bullets: Designed the end-to-end experience and interaction model for a real-time multiplayer VR product, giving users hands-on control of movement, camera, and pacing through explorable 3D worlds.

Turned complex scientific data (James Webb Space Telescope, NASA) into an intuitive, immediate creative experience, and built a generative-AI production pipeline to prototype and iterate content quickly.
Piloted at the Telus World of Science (603 guests, 4.84/5 satisfaction, NPS 84) and distributed across 400+ venues; invited to speak on location-based entertainment at GamesCon Canada.

jobs.title: Design & Prototyping Lead
bullets: Lead product discovery and end-to-end design for institutional clients, turning ambiguous requirements into clear, working experiences on tight timelines.
Prototype quickly to explore, test, and refine interaction and workflow concepts before committing to build.

Built ELIXR's design and prototyping practice from scratch (reusable patterns, workflows, and craft standards) and partner with developers and artists to carry concepts through to high-quality implementation.
**City of Calgary, WAVE Technology Centre:** designed and delivered four proof-of-concept XR experiences (VR training, mixed-reality, smart-glasses, 360 video), each from concept through testing.
**Red Deer Polytechnic & Alberta Sports Hall of Fame:** designed an interactive projector-based simulation, leading UX, real-time interaction, and on-site experience design.
**NAIT:** designed an AI-driven VR training experience with a real-time, multimodal feedback loop that grades users as they speak.
**Edmonton Chinatown Heritage Association:** designed a phone-based AR experience where users scan murals to reveal 3D animations, focused on simple, discoverable spatial interaction.

jobs.title: Partner & Studio Lead
bullets: Run a studio designing and building immersive, real-time, and AI-driven products end to end for clients across creative and institutional domains.

header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: Product & UX Designer · Real-Time 3D · AI-Driven Creative Tools

body: I'm applying for the Product UX Designer role because Intangible Studio is the product I would most want to design: real-time 3D and generative AI in the hands of creatives, with control over composition, camera, and animation. Making something that powerful feel simple and immediate is the problem I keep choosing to work on.

I design and ship at exactly this intersection. With Adventure Portal I designed the end-to-end experience and interaction model for a real-time multiplayer VR product, giving users hands-on control of movement and camera through explorable 3D worlds; it piloted at the Telus World of Science (4.84/5, NPS 84) and distributed to 400+ venues. I lead product discovery and prototyping for institutional clients, turning ambiguous problems into clear, working experiences, and I partner closely with engineers and artists to carry ideas through to high-quality implementation. I prototype as a way of thinking, and I care a lot about clarity, craft, and the small interaction details.

I'd love to help shape how teams create and collaborate in Intangible Studio. I'd point you to my work for the proof: I'm glad to walk through case studies and prototypes that show the problem framing and system-level thinking behind each one.
